uniclove.title: Uniclove
uniclove.description: A dating & social app with swipe-based matching, integrated UI real-time messaging (WebSocket), and premium membership, built on a microservices architecture.

dms.title: Distribution Management System
dms.description: ERP mobile app for sales, warehousing and distribution, with GPS-based field check-in, route visualization and a layered service architecture.

warehouse.title: Warehouse Management System
warehouse.description: Multi-company warehouse app: goods receipt, picking/delivery, stock-taking and order tracking with reusable scan-driven forms.

saleorder.title: Sale Order App
saleorder.description: ERP sales-order module: multi-step order creation, SKU & price lists, tax computation, invoice printing and FCM deep-linked notifications.

purchaseorder.title: Purchase Order App
purchaseorder.description: ERP procurement app: end-to-end PO workflow, vendor & invoice modules, VAT calculation and goods-receipt with a Screen–Hook architecture.

decallfs.title: Decall FS
decallfs.description: Field-service app for a Japanese client (Flutter, iOS/Android): migrated features from a legacy system, built request-mail history with PDF viewer, WEB reports, equipment requests and PC non-use applications; fixed CP932 garbled text and shipped to the App Store/Google Play.

About.title: about-me
About.body: I'm a Mobile Developer at Kaopiz with over 2 years of experience delivering cross-platform mobile applications and business solutions for Japanese clients. I work with React Native (TypeScript) and Flutter (Dart), with solid skills in API integration, state management and performance optimization, and I also contribute to backend development with Spring Boot and MySQL. I graduated in Information Technology from the Banking Academy of Vietnam (2021–2025) and keep learning to build scalable, high-quality applications.
